mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of all trading days, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which are associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2.0% and the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, the combination signals a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0 AND UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signal strong consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1300 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals weak economic supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1350 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, the combination signals a demand-supply mismatch that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1350 AND INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 251.0 signals accelerating inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 251.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) below 148000 signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 148000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
